newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji agrees on new Tobishima restructuring - paper.
newsitem.headline: Fuji agrees on new Tobishima restructuring - paper.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd and Tobishima Corp, which is burdened by property-related debts, have agreed on a new restructuring plan for Tobishima, a Japanese newspaper said on Friday.

The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said the new plan agreed with Fuji proposes that creditor financial institutions should not hold Tobishima responsible for bad debts worth about 650 billion yen which it transferred to one of its units under a previous restructuring programme.
Under the 1992 restructuring plan, Tobishima had guaranteed the debts, the newspaper said.
Fuji and Tobishima were not immediately available for comment.
Also under the new restructuring programme, Tobishima will ask creditor institutions to further cut interest rates on its debts, the paper said.
There are more than 30 creditor institutions including Fuji, the paper said.
Tobishima will announce its new plan on Friday, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.
